Re: Robert Carter

Unique ghoul with 1 life.
During your untap phase, Carter's employer burns 1 blood, or Carter is burned. The vampire with this retainer gets +2 bleed.

The punctuation implies that he has to burn the blood if he can, but would like to know for sure.

THank you kindly

Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Burning Carter instead of one blood is valid.

On the other hand, I would not wait a turn to take over a Temptationed Jost who has Robert Carter and one blood (assuming Temptation was played at superior)...
